_desc_MAX_PER_QUERY: Top links to harvest per search angle. 3 means top 3 authoritative URLs per query (Default: 3)
_desc_MAX_WORKERS: Number of parallel scraper threads running concurrently via Jina Reader (Default: 5)
_desc_MAX_CHARS: Maximum character limit extracted per webpage to keep content dense and avoid bloat (Default: 12000)
_desc_MIN_SEARCH_ANGLES: Minimum search perspectives formulated by the Router for diverse multi-angle coverage (Default: 5)
_desc_MAX_SEARCH_ANGLES: Maximum search perspectives formulated by the Router (Default: 7, allows up to 9 for complex topics)
